name: What is the difference between storm damage repair and replacement assessments?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between storm damage repair and replacement assessments?

acceptedAnswer.text: A storm damage repair assessment determines the specific areas of your roof that can be fixed, such as replacing a few damaged shingles. A replacement assessment evaluates if the damage is widespread enough to warrant a full roof replacement. Our experts at Discounted Roofing Co. assess both options to provide the most cost-effective and durable solution for your property, considering the extent of damage and roof age.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair assessments focus on fixing specific damage, while replacement assessments consider the need for a new roof due to widespread damage.
